findings.evidence: The shared assumptions occur at line 76; lines 89 and 95 prove smoothness solely through contDiff_const_smul and composition. Mathlib/Analysis/Calculus/ContDiff/Operations.lean:587–593 gives contDiff_const_smul under DistribSMul, SMulCommClass and ContinuousConstSMul, without an inner product or norm-multiplicative action.
findings.fix: For contDiff_quaternionFrame use [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [DistribSMul ℍᵐᵒᵖ E] [ContinuousConstSMul ℍᵐᵒᵖ E] [SMulCommClass ℝ ℍᵐᵒᵖ E]. For contMDiff_quaternionFrame retain the sphere's inner-product and dimension assumptions but use the same weaker action assumptions.
findings.issue: Both contDiff_quaternionFrame and contMDiff_quaternionFrame unnecessarily require a quaternion module with norm-multiplicative action; contDiff_quaternionFrame also unnecessarily requires an inner product.

summary: The smoothness declarations retain stronger structural assumptions than their proofs require.
